youtube_title: The Fruitcake That Comes Out Of The Freezer Every November
description:
Every November, one fruitcake in a crown climbs out of the garage freezer and declares it Christmas. This year, the frozen turkey has something to say.

#cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #christmas
tiktok_caption: every november she climbs out of the freezer and nobody can stop her #cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #christmas

lines.text: Mom. The old freezer in the garage is humming again. Very high. Like it wants attention.
What is today's date?
November second.
Get the good towels. It is time.
Darlings. It is time.
Mom, that is a fruitcake in a crown.
I am the fruitcake. There are others. They are not me.
This is Clementine. She comes out of the deep freezer every November. Then it is Christmas.
Halloween was two days ago. I still have candy in my hoodie.
Adorable. Burn the hoodie.
You're a day late, you know. Everybody else started yesterday.
I am never late. The world was early.
Malik, go take down the skeleton.
Why is the skeleton already wearing a Santa hat?
He read the room. He has no eyes, and he read the room.
Oh no. She's going to do the note.
What note?
Cover the dog. Open a window. Hold on to something you love.
Everyone quiet, please. I require a moment of silence before my moment.
Did it start?
It started four seconds ago. Only dogs can hear it.
The whole street is howling.
That is my audience. They have waited all year.
Excuse me.
Who said that?
That came from the kitchen freezer. Oh, not this year. Earl, please.
Mom. The turkey is talking.
You bet I am. I have a holiday in twenty four days, and nobody asked me anything.
Oh. The frozen bird. Earl, darling. You are still here.
I am the next holiday, Clementine. I am next. You are cutting the line.
Thanksgiving is the opening act, darling.
I have a parade. A whole parade. Nobody in it is wearing a crown.
Nobody watches a parade for the bird.
There is a giant bird in that parade. That is my cousin.
Can you two please take this to the pantry?
I cannot. I have been frozen solid since March. I am a brick with opinions.
Hang on. Earl has ice all over his beanie. Clementine, you have no ice at all.
I am a professional. I do not show it.
Mom, the old freezer is warm. There is a note taped on the back.
That's your grandfather's handwriting. Unplugged it in two thousand eleven. Needed the outlet.
Fifteen years. She has not been frozen for fifteen years.
Then what have you been doing in there?
Standing. In the dark. In character.
Humming, so that you would find me.
And you never go bad?
I am a fruitcake. Nothing happens to me. I will be here when the sun goes out.
Why is there a gift tag on your back?
Oh. Sweetheart, do not read that.
To Dee, from Aunt Ruth. To Aunt Ruth, from Dee. To Dee, from Aunt Ruth. Nineteen ninety eight.
You are not a tradition. You are a package nobody will keep.
Darling, I have been mailed to Ohio fourteen times. That is called touring.
She's not wrong. It is a tour.
Mom, there is a package on the porch. From Aunt Ruth. It is humming.
Higher than the last one.
Oh no. My understudy.
It is time.
